title: Heliocentric Distance Chronology: JPL Horizons Root Generation, Validation, and Historical-Test Reproducibility
description: Version 1.1.0 extends the validated Heliocentric Distance Chronology software archive with publication-facing reproducibility materials for two companion studies. It preserves the validated 1–8, 3–6, and 7–9 root catalogues; adds the independently frozen Armenian historical analysis input for Paper 3; documents the preregistered H1 tests, deterministic cluster robustness, and the corrected direct exact-day historical rule for 7–9 and 3–6 roots; and records a JD/TDB calendar-normalization audit. The Paper 3 confirmatory analyses do not support enrichment of the preregistered Armenian negative state-transition hypothesis. Historical selection remained frozen before astronomical inspection.

notes: The v1.0.0 clean-room astronomical baseline remains unchanged. Version 1.1.0 adds Paper 2 provenance materials and the independently frozen, calendar-normalized Paper 3 historical-test layer. Astronomical instants are keyed by JD/TDB; historical civil-day comparison uses the Julian calendar before 15 October 1582 and the Gregorian calendar thereafter.
